'''Beskad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Dar'manda]], a group of former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] operating in [[Mek-Sha]] during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Slugfall" />
